note: Ranked failure-mode hypotheses per cell (rank 1 = most likely main cause of ~0% final success). status: confirmed = shown directly by the analysis; supported = consistent evidence, not isolated by an intervention; open = untested. Evidence keys refer to out/*.json and REPORT.md sections.

checked_and_clean: manifest 55/55 complete, one attempt each, no resumes, no failed attempts
config hashes and resolved configs equal baseline_plan.json; plan file equals plan code
budgets exact; sum of training-episode lengths equals the last episode's global_step in every run; 21 eval points at 0,5%,...,100%; 200/100 final episodes
gradient-update counts equal the analytic expectation in every run
training seeds 1-5, env reset seed 10,000,000+1000*seed, eval episode seeds 1,000,000+/2,000,000+ identical across all 55 runs; no two seeds of a cell share their first 50 training episodes
single code revision f772875 for all runs, code-identical to validated 7d94a93 (differences are docs and play_human only); HEAD has no code change since
devices as planned: colour on RTX 3090 (CUDA), delivery and maintenance on CPU
rewards, terminated and truncated flags reach every learner's buffer exactly as the env emits them (SB3 DQN/DQN-TS, SB3 PPO/PPO-RM/RecurrentPPO incl. timeout bootstrap, DRQN, QRM, QRM-Cue)
QRM/QRM-Cue: the actual RM head is always a valid counterfactual head with the env's reward, next head and terminal flag
FrameReplay transitions and R2D2 sequences (incl. ring wrap-around, burn-in, episode-start alignment): 29,271 synthetic checks, 0 errors
SB3 DQN, SB3 PPO and sb3-contrib RecurrentPPO all bootstrap time-limit truncations (TimeLimit.truncated set by DummyVecEnv)
target-network sync every 2,000/10,000 env steps; epsilon 1.0 -> 0.05 linearly over the first 20% in every run
training vs frozen-snapshot delivery gap: same on eval and diagnostic seeds; a snapshot mixture reproduces the training numbers (policy churn, not a mismatch)
logging_gaps_not_affecting_results: SB3 DQN / DQN-TS rows in train_updates.csv carry only the loss of the last gradient step of the interval and no Q-value or gradient norm (computed here from snapshots instead)
the final forced flush row of custom agents (DRQN, QRM, QRM-Cue) has empty loss/q_mean/grad_norm
RecurrentPPO value predictions are not exposed through the analysis helper; value loss and explained variance are logged
design_issues_affecting_interpretation: maintenance: gamma 0.99 at 60 control steps per simulated second makes the task rewards nearly invisible (oracle discounted return -4.9 vs about -2 to -10 for hovering in place)
greedy evaluation of value-based agents in partially observable tasks: frozen greedy policies fall into 2-step loops; exploratory behaviour differs from the evaluated policy
normalised return is dominated by penalty avoidance (a stand-still policy scores 0.39 in delivery, 0.08 in colour, ~0.8 for hovering in maintenance)

invalidates_baseline_results.explanation: No pipeline defect was found, so the 55 runs are a faithful record of protocol v2 with untuned defaults. They do not support an RQ1 ranking: every cell is at ~0% success, the differences in normalised return reflect penalty avoidance, and in maintenance the gamma/time-scale mismatch means the training objective does not favour solving the task. Report them as a valid negative baseline, not as evidence about explicit vs implicit memory.

delivery/dqn.hypothesis: Search-and-survive exploration: local 4-neighbour sensing, layouts re-drawn every episode and 5% lava make the 3-delivery + goal chain rare under epsilon-greedy; the value function learns safety (timeouts) instead.
delivery/dqn.evidence: late epsilon-0.05 episodes: 0.7-5.3% success, ~45% lava; DQN-TS (given task state) also 0% eval success
delivery/dqn.cheapest_diagnostic: DQN-TS 300k steps with num_packages=1, and with percent_death_squares=0 (seed 401)

delivery/dqn.hypothesis: No good frozen policy: greedy snapshots fall into 2-cycles; training-time deliveries come from policy churn (weights change every 4 steps).
delivery/dqn.evidence: 100% of greedy rollouts cycle by step 3-5; frozen snapshot at eps 0.05 delivers 0.24-0.37/ep vs 0.81-1.05 in training; snapshot mixture restores 1.01-1.30
delivery/dqn.cheapest_diagnostic: snapshot mixture on the 200 final-eval seeds (no training)

delivery/dqn.evidence: Q(s0) 12-28 vs realised greedy discounted return ~0; QRM heads up to 120 > bound 80
delivery/dqn.cheapest_diagnostic: Double-DQN target, 300k steps, Q vs Monte-Carlo return (seed 401)

delivery/dqn.cheapest_diagnostic: linear probe of LSTM state for carried/delivered on 50 rollouts (no training)

maintenance/ppo.hypothesis: Discount horizon: gamma 0.99 at 60 Hz makes task rewards invisible; the oracle is not better than hovering under the trained objective.
maintenance/ppo.evidence: oracle discounted return (gamma 0.99) -4.9 vs hover -2 to -10, fall-and-rest -54; first reward at step ~667 (weight 0.0012), completion at ~1,380 (8e-6); gamma 0.999 oracle +287
maintenance/ppo.cheapest_diagnostic: PPO-RM with gamma 0.999 (or action repeat 8) for 2M steps, seed 401

maintenance/ppo.hypothesis: Penalty dominance and action saturation: -5/step boundary and -1000 exits; unbounded Gaussian clipped to [-1,1] with ent_coef 0 collapses std to 0.05-0.1 at the bound.
maintenance/ppo.evidence: 9/15 final policies have means beyond the bound; 9/15 fall and rest on the boundary; std 0.05-0.1
maintenance/ppo.cheapest_diagnostic: second arm of the run above with ent_coef 0.01 and reward-only VecNormalize
